name: com.gamecore.gameplay.save
description: Plugin catalog row 12 (SADR-012): the authorable save schema (slot schemas with their current versions, the forward migration ids a save may need, compatible catalog fingerprints), the typed save.capture / save.restore / save.delete commands handled at host level by the application root's SaveService, the SaveWritten / SaveRestored / SaveRefused{code,hint} events, the ISaveSlotCatalog a save menu reads, and the save.inspect and save.testRoundTrip Studio operations. It holds no component state and no save UI; every refusal is one of the SaveService's typed codes.
